This editorial illustration features a purple and pink background with several key visual elements. At the top, the large white capitalized text "TEMPO" is prominent. Below it, smaller white text reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN". To the left of the main title, white text reads "Siasat Partai Gurem Menjaring Suara H.30" and to the right, "Kisruh Alih Kelola Bandara Halim H.76".

The central focus is a wooden-textured picture frame tilted to the right. Inside the frame is an illustration of a man and a woman. The man is on the left, wearing a blue military-style uniform with multiple medals and pins on his chest. The woman stands to the right, wearing a pink blazer. To the left of the frame, a black semi-automatic handgun is positioned vertically, pointing downwards and slightly towards the frame. Its textured grip and slide are visible. 

At the bottom right, large black text reads "MOTIF PEMBUNUHAN BRIGADIR YOSUA". Below this is a block of smaller black text: "Putri Candrawathi, istri Inspektur Jenderal Ferdy Sambo, turut menjadi tersangka pembunuhan berencana Brigadir Yosua. Peristiwa Magelang jadi pemicu. H.62". In the bottom left corner, there is a barcode, a QR code, the date "22-28 AGUSTUS 2022", and the price "RP 50.000". Additional publication details and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273" are also present.
